comparison.objective: Place sandbags on the stand legs located under two booms.
comparison.physical_skill: Interpret stand geometry, orient bags, and place them at specified offsets.
comparison.success_condition: One flat, lengthwise bag lies on each correct leg, 7–13 cm from its post.
comparison.reason: Convention-aware placement does not test commissioning or retained fine adjustment. Stand tipping is explicitly not simulated, unlike the candidate's required dynamic physics.
